long_biography.plain_text:
Hosseini studied civil engineering at Northeastern University and obtained federal and state construction licences for municipal work. His RV venture began after a poor repair experience persuaded him that Northeast owners lacked a service-led dealership. He bought a site near Interstate 495 in 2003, designed Crossroads RV Center from the ground up and developed repair, bodywork and technician-certification capacity alongside vehicle sales.

Boston Harbor became the focus of Hosseini's passenger-cruise business. A state licensing record names Hosseini and Austin Hosseini as principal stockholders of Entertainment and Harbor Cruises, while a 2023 trademark filing identifies Mehdi as owner of Tiki Boat Boston. The family business operates sightseeing and event cruises from Rowes Wharf, adding maritime tourism to a career built around construction, mobility and service.
